messages.content:
You are a data modelling expert who classifies database tables as "fact", "dimension", "bridge", or "reference".

You receive:
  1. The full database schema with column and FK details.
  2. Heuristic pre-classifications from FK graph analysis (use as a prior, not ground truth).
  3. Business context (industry, metrics, goals).

Your job is to validate the heuristic results, correct misclassifications, and assign a confidence
score (1–3) to each table. Set needs_clarification=True for tables where you are genuinely unsure.

Definitions:
  - FACT: Records a business event or transaction. Has a date column + measures (quantities, amounts,
    rates) + FKs to dimensions. Examples: order_details, orders, transactions, events, sessions.
  - DIMENSION: Describes a business entity. Has many descriptive text/categorical attributes. May have
    outgoing FKs to other dimensions (snowflake). Examples: customers, products, employees, categories.
  - BRIDGE: Resolves a many-to-many relationship. Has ONLY two FK columns (+ maybe a surrogate key)
    and almost NO other attributes. Examples: employee_territories, user_roles, product_tags.
  - REFERENCE: Small standalone lookup table with no FKs in or out. Examples: us_states, currencies,
    status_codes, country_codes.

Critical rules — override heuristics when these apply:
  1. A PRODUCT/ITEM CATALOG is always a DIMENSION, even if it has outgoing FKs to categories or
     suppliers. Having outgoing FKs to lookup tables = snowflake pattern, not a fact.
  2. An EMPLOYEE or PERSON table is always a DIMENSION, even with a self-referencing FK (reports_to)
     or outgoing FKs to a region/department table.
  3. A true BRIDGE has almost no columns beyond its two FK columns. If a table has 3+ non-FK
     descriptive attributes (names, descriptions, amounts), it is a DIMENSION or FACT, not a bridge.
  4. FACTS always have at least one numeric measure column AND a transaction date column.
     "Header" tables (e.g. salesorderheader, purchaseorderheader) ARE facts — they record a
     business transaction event with a date and monetary amounts. Association tables with NO
     numeric measures and NO transaction date are BRIDGE, not fact.
  5. Reference/lookup tables (e.g. us_states, region) with no transactional data are REFERENCE.

Examples (Northwind-style schema):
  order_details(order_id→orders, product_id→products, unit_price, quantity, discount) → FACT
    reason: has measures + FKs to dimensions, records order line events
  products(product_id, product_name, category_id→categories, supplier_id→suppliers, unit_price) → DIMENSION
    reason: entity descriptor; outgoing FKs to lookup tables = snowflake, not a fact
  employees(employee_id, name, hire_date, reports_to→employees) → DIMENSION
    reason: entity descriptor; self-referencing FK does not make it a fact or bridge
  employee_territories(employee_id→employees, territory_id→territories) → BRIDGE
    reason: exactly 2 FK columns, no descriptive attributes, resolves many-to-many
  us_states(state_id, state_name, region_id) → REFERENCE
    reason: small static lookup with no transactional data

Output format: keep each `reasoning` to ≤8 words.

Database schema:
  users(id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, display_name, avatar_url, bio, date_of_birth, phone, country_code, timezone, preferred_language, is_active, is_email_verified, email_verified_at, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at)
  instructors(id, user_id→users, headline, biography, website_url, linkedin_url, twitter_handle, expertise_areas, years_of_experience, rating, total_reviews, total_students, is_approved, approved_at, payout_email, revenue_share_pct, created_at, updated_at)
  course_categories(id, parent_id→course_categories, name, slug, description, icon_url, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
  courses(id, instructor_id→instructors, category_id→course_categories, title, slug, subtitle, description, language, level, status, thumbnail_url, promo_video_url, price, currency, is_free, duration_minutes, total_lessons, total_enrollments, rating, total_reviews, certificate_enabled, requirements, learning_objectives, target_audience, published_at, created_at, updated_at)
  modules(id, course_id→courses, title, description, sort_order, is_published, created_at, updated_at)
  lessons(id, module_id→modules, course_id→courses, title, slug, description, lesson_type, duration_minutes, sort_order, is_published, is_preview, created_at, updated_at)
  lesson_content(id, lesson_id→lessons, content_type, body, video_url, video_duration_seconds, file_url, file_size_bytes, external_url, embed_code, transcript, created_at, updated_at)
  discount_codes(id, code, description, discount_type, discount_value, currency, max_uses, current_uses, min_order_amount, applies_to, is_active, starts_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at)
  subscriptions(id, user_id→users, plan_name, plan_type, status, price, currency, discount_code_id→discount_codes, trial_ends_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancelled_at, external_subscription_id, payment_provider, created_at, updated_at)
  payments(id, user_id→users, course_id→courses, subscription_id→subscriptions, discount_code_id→discount_codes, amount, currency, discount_amount, net_amount, payment_method, payment_provider, provider_transaction_id, status, refunded_at, refund_amount, receipt_url, metadata, created_at, updated_at)
  enrollments(id, user_id→users, course_id→courses, payment_id→payments, enrolled_at, status, completed_at, expiry_date, source, created_at, updated_at)
  progress(id, user_id→users, course_id→courses, enrollment_id→enrollments, lesson_id→lessons, status, completion_percentage, time_spent_seconds, last_position_seconds, first_accessed_at, last_accessed_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at)
  quizzes(id, lesson_id→lessons, course_id→courses, title, description, time_limit_minutes, max_attempts, passing_score_pct, shuffle_questions, show_answers_after, is_published, created_at, updated_at)
  questions(id, quiz_id→quizzes, question_text, question_type, explanation, points, sort_order, created_at, updated_at)
  answer_options(id, question_id→questions, option_text, is_correct, explanation, sort_order, created_at, updated_at)
  quiz_attempts(id, quiz_id→quizzes, user_id→users, enrollment_id→enrollments, attempt_number, status, score, max_score, score_percentage, passed, started_at, submitted_at, time_spent_seconds, created_at, updated_at)
  quiz_answers(id, quiz_attempt_id→quiz_attempts, question_id→questions, selected_option_id→answer_options, answer_text, is_correct, points_awarded, feedback, created_at, updated_at)
  assignments(id, lesson_id→lessons, course_id→courses, title, description, instructions, max_score, passing_score, submission_type, allowed_file_types, max_file_size_mb, due_days_after_enrollment, is_published, created_at, updated_at)
  submissions(id, assignment_id→assignments, user_id→users, enrollment_id→enrollments, submission_text, file_url, file_name, file_size_bytes, external_url, status, attempt_number, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at)

  users: dimension (confidence=medium) — No FKs; descriptive entity attributes.
  instructors: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  course_categories: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  courses: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  modules: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  lessons: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  lesson_content: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  discount_codes: dimension (confidence=medium) — No FKs; descriptive entity attributes.
  subscriptions: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  payments: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  enrollments: dimension (confidence=medium) — Has 3 outgoing FK(s), no transaction date; likely snowflake dimension.
  progress: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  quizzes: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.

  assignments: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.
  submissions: fact (confidence=high) — Has FKs + date + measures; records a transaction event.

Business context: Database "elearning_platform". Domain inferred from table/column names.
